 Doctor X K-drama ratings — Kim Ji-won’s Drama Threatens So Ji-sub’s Grand Prize
 Oct 24, 2026 4:09 PM PDT 
 [OSEN=Lee Dae-sun] On the afternoon of the 7th, the production presentation for the SBS Friday-Saturday drama ‘Doctor X : Age of the White Mafia’ was held at Mok-dong SBS in Seoul. Actress Kim Ji-won is posing for photos. 
 Doctor X K-drama ratings are surging rapidly, putting pressure on actor So Ji-sub as Kim Ji-won’s explosive popularity continues to break records. The SBS Friday-Saturday drama ‘Doctor X: Age of the White Mafia’ has already come close to hitting the milestone 20% viewership mark.
 According to Nielsen Korea on the 25th, the 6th episode of ‘Doctor X’ broadcast on the 24th recorded a nationwide household rating of 19.5%. This is a 2% increase compared to the 5th episode, which recorded 17.5%.
 The drama recorded a peak rating of 21.3%, breaking its own best viewership record yet again. It also ranked first in its time slot across national and metropolitan areas, as well as sweeping first place for Saturday and weekly miniseries, proving its undeniable top position. The key 2049 demographic rating also demonstrated overwhelming box office power, peaking at 7.67% and averaging 6.9%.
 The latest broadcast drew high viewer immersion by recalling the first encounter between Kang Seo-jung (played by Kim Ji-won) and the late boy Baraka (played by Jeon Ji-on). Working as a medical volunteer in the war-torn country of Ragota, Kang Seo-jung faced mortal danger from a soldier but survived with Baraka’s help. Baraka asked if she was the ‘Doctor X’ known as the hand of god and asked for help for his younger sister Nima, who was shot. The heartbreaking scene of Kang Seo-jung and Baraka plunging into the battlefield amidst flying bullets to save Nima deeply moved viewers.
 ‘Doctor X’ continues to break its own highest viewership ratings every single week. Starting off at 11.4%, the drama recorded 14.9% for episode 2, 15.1% for episode 3, and 18.5% for episode 4.
 With viewership approaching 20% by just the 6th episode, breaking the 20% threshold seems to be only a matter of time given its current upward trajectory.
 Ahead of the year-end acting awards, Kim Ji-won’s main competitor So Ji-sub previously starred in ‘Manager Kim’, which notably surpassed 20% ratings in just four episodes. However, with both dramas showing similar upward trends, attention is focused on who will ultimately take home the grand prize trophy.
 Interest is naturally high regarding how far the ratings for ‘Doctor X’ will climb, especially since it has maintained a steady upward curve so far.
 Aside from television ratings, ‘Doctor X’ is also displaying exceptional buzz. According to Good Data Corporation’s FUNdex for the second week of October released on October 12th, ‘Doctor X’ claimed the number one spot in TV-OTT buzz rankings within its very first week of broadcast.
 Combined with global box office fever via Netflix, ‘Doctor X’ claimed the number one spot in Korea’s Top 10 TV shows and rose to fourth place in the global Top 10 TV shows category. It achieved stellar records by entering the Top 10 in 67 countries worldwide and ranking first in 8 countries, including South Korea.
 Before the premiere of ‘Doctor X’, So Ji-sub’s grand prize win for ‘Manager Kim’ seemed all but certain. However, with Kim Ji-won’s stellar performance driving ‘Doctor X’ onto a winning streak, all eyes are on who will ultimately smile at the year-end awards ceremony.
